_comment: JPMorgan-style commercial credit policy thresholds. These are illustrative reference defaults — your institution's credit policy and risk committee define the actual values. Search [DEV] in policy_loader.py to find where these are consumed.

approval_tiers._comment: [DEV] Define your institution's approval authority thresholds here. These determine which approval workflow is triggered in approval_routing.py.

ratio_thresholds._comment: [DEV] Thresholds vary by industry. Add industries as needed. Confirm all values with your credit risk team before production use. Two ratios from the case study Step 5 list are not yet defined here — quick_ratio_min (needs inventory field in schemas.py) and gross_margin_min (needs cost_of_goods_sold or gross_profit field in schemas.py). Once those fields are added to FinancialStatements, add their thresholds to each industry block below following the same pattern as dscr_min.

kyc_policy._comment: [DEV] Define review cycle lengths per risk tier. These determine when the KYC Agent flags a stale review.

osint_policy._comment: [DEV] Define which OSINT severity levels are credit-blocking vs. disclosure-only.

macro_overlay._comment: [DEV] Plain-text overlay injected into the Reasoning Agent prompt. Update manually when your credit committee issues a sector-specific caution or macro view. Not a live data feed — a deliberate, human-set signal reviewed alongside the credit policy. Set to null or empty string to disable.
macro_overlay.global: Current macro environment: moderate rate volatility, selective caution on highly leveraged structures. Monitor input cost pressures in manufacturing and retail sectors (tariff-driven, Q2 2026 forward). No broad credit freeze — sector-specific awareness only.
macro_overlay.INDUSTRIAL_MANUFACTURING: Elevated caution: tariff-driven raw material and component cost volatility may compress EBITDA margins in Q2–Q3 2026. Require explicit management commentary on hedging strategy and supplier contract terms before approval.
macro_overlay.RETAIL: Elevated caution: consumer discretionary spend softening in Q2 2026. Require updated 12-month cash flow forecast with downside scenario before approval.

covenant_guidelines._comment: [DEV] Covenant headroom percentages — how much buffer above policy minimum the covenant should be set at. Adjust per your institution's structuring standards.
